summary: Recheck the original problem with consistent scope and follow an operation from its request to its result. Wombat improves Skill repair verification, historical evidence retrieval and installation diagnostics without changing Token or pricing accounting.
highlights: Recheck global Skills with fresh native discovery and the original project scope. Local missing references keep a stable problem identity through missing, repaired and restored states.

Read located requests and results with history read RECORD --turn TURN --operation OPERATION. Successful recovery results and commands embedded in completion-only records are available; long text retains bounded continuation.
Retrieve dated history using existing frame time ranges. Continuation treats an omitted zero offset consistently and reports actionable cursor mismatch details.
Keep explicitly inherited operation records as source evidence without treating them as fresh execution endpoints. Partial activity checks can report reliable eligible-command subset results.
Distinguish naming-only Skill specification reminders from runtime faults, and keep project applicability separate from ownership of global or managed files.
Preserve compatible-bundle facts and specific installation failures even when verification exits with status 1. Parsing warnings remain separate from the actual failure cause.
Use the Skill workflow to recover original requirements, expected negative tests, failures, later handling and verified outcomes before proposing a repair.
knownLimitations: One operation ID identifies one invocation, not a causal chain of later attempts. Codex still interprets cross-turn tasks and verifies business resolution; outer tool success does not prove every inner command succeeded.
Unsupported tool text forms and incomplete source coverage retain explicit gaps. Partial zero use observations alone do not justify disabling or deleting a Skill.
Conversation request/results use protocol v3 and optimize responses use v7. Update the CLI, plugin and integrations together; older response formats are rejected without compatibility handling.
Environment configuration does not prove live MCP connectivity, actual Hook execution or model adoption. No automatic rollback or savings claim is added.
